info.description: Local-first job discovery and application platform. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details.
info.title: Jobs Platform API

post.summary: Run the scheduled synchronization now (skipped if one is already running)

get.summary: Who is signed in, and whether the one-time setup is needed (also issues the CSRF cookie)

post.description: Takes over the pre-login single-user account if it exists, so its data is kept. Sign in afterwards.
post.summary: Create the first account (ADMIN); only from this machine and only once

post.description: Any kind, e.g. an EmployerSet. Max 5 MB.

get.description: Filters combine with AND. Archived employers are excluded unless includeArchived=true.

put.description: Requires the version last read; returns 409 if it changed meanwhile.

post.description: Soft delete: hidden from search and discovery, history retained.

delete.description: Bindings are never deleted because discovered listings reference them.

put.summary: Create or reconfigure a binding of the employer to a job source

get.summary: Export employers as CSV or as a re-importable YAML EmployerSet

post.description: Rechecks availability, evaluates the match, generates fact-backed documents and answer drafts, and validates that every statement is traceable to your verified facts. Idempotent: unchanged inputs give UNCHANGED.

put.summary: Answer a question yourself (blank clears it)

post.description: Send the id of the package you reviewed; refused if it is no longer current or not complete.
post.summary: Approve the current package for one submission

delete.summary: Close the window (the attempt stays in progress until you report its outcome)

post.description: Requires an Idempotency-Key. Fills only values that are certain and come from your approved package; pauses on sign-in, CAPTCHA challenges and one-time codes. Never presses Submit.
post.summary: Use the approval and open the form in a browser window
After you pressed Submit: look for the confirmation and record it as evidence
Continue after you resolved a pause (inspect and fill again; never overwrites what you typed)

put.description: Each statement must cite your verified facts (factIds) or be your own approved text (userApproved=true). Untraceable statements are rejected. Creates a new package version.

post.description: Requires an Idempotency-Key header; replays return the same attempt. You then submit in your browser and report the outcome.
CONFIRMED needs evidence; FAILED needs a description; UNCONFIRMED when unsure (blocks any retry until you verify).
Only you can: CONFIRMED (with evidence) or FAILED.
Facts are marked UNVERIFIED unless trust=true; confirm them via /verification. Max 5 MB.
post.summary: Import one of your candidate profiles (YAML, kind CandidateProfile)

put.description: Facts keep the verification status you send: this is your own statement. Identical content is a no-op.
put.summary: Save a new version of a profile (created if missing)

post.description: Raw body with Content-Type application/pdf, the DOCX type, text/plain or text/markdown. Max 5 MB. It is never modified; generated resumes are separate documents.
Marks the listed (or all) UNVERIFIED facts as VERIFIED in a new version. Only verified facts count in matching and generated documents.

get.summary: Download all your data (profiles, applications, documents list, tracking, preferences, audit)
Matches for your profiles' current versions, best first

post.description: Employers you IGNORE are skipped. Idempotent: unchanged results are reported as such.

post.summary: Import one of your own role profiles (YAML, kind RoleProfile)
Copy a template into your own profiles, to tune it

get.description: stale=true: not closed but not seen recently (a flag, never a closure).

post.summary: Recheck a posting's availability at its sources

get.description: Your own profiles and the shared templates.
Your own profile with this key if you have one, otherwise the template.

put.description: An enabled source needs an installed adapter and settings valid for it. Settings may hold secret references (env:NAME) only.
put.summary: Create or replace a job source

post.description: All active bindings, or narrowed by source and/or employer. Runs synchronously; dryRun reports what would change without changing anything.
